job.title: Pastry Chef (Assistant)
job.description:
We are hiring a Pastry Chef (Assistant) for a restaurant in Maitama, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.

Responsibilities

  • Assist the pastry chef in preparing and baking pastries, cakes, bread and desserts to the restaurant's standard.
  • Prepare doughs, fillings, ingredients and decorations ahead of service.
  • Keep the pastry section clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards.
  • Help monitor stock and report shortages.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years' relevant pastry or kitchen experience
  • Good communication skills
  • Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision
  • Able to commute to Maitama, Abuja and resume immediately
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Sous Chef
job.description:

  • Prepare and cook dishes to a consistent standard and check quality before food leaves the kitchen.

  • Help with stock control, ordering and keeping waste low.

  • Good communication skills
  • Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision
  • Able to commute to Maitama, Abuja and resume immediately
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
We are hiring an Accountant in Gwarimpa, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for an experienced accountant.

Responsibilities

  • Keep accurate books of account and prepare regular ledger and bank reconciliations.
  • Prepare and file tax and other statutory returns on time.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports for management.

Requirements

  • B.Sc or HND in Accounting, Finance or a related field
  • ICAN or ACCA (certified or part-qualified)
  • 4 Years' Experience in Accounting
  • Knowledge of Nigerian tax rules
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Professional development support.
  • Performance bonus.
  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Tech Sales Closer
job.description:
We are hiring a Tech Sales Closer for our sales team. This is a remote role open to applicants in Nigeria, with a base pay of ₦100,000 per month plus uncapped commission on closed deals.

Responsibilities

  • Close warm leads by taking qualified prospects from first call through to a signed deal.
  • Keep a clear pipeline: record every lead, follow up on proposals and report on deals closed.
  • Work to a monthly sales target.

Requirements

  • 2 Years' Experience in Sales
  • Proven record of closing deals
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Remote working arrangement.
  • Uncapped commission on every deal you close.
  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Chef
job.description:
We are hiring a Chef for a hotel and apartments company in Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and cook meals to a consistent standard of quality for hotel and apartment guests.
  • Plan menus and portions, and suggest new dishes.
  • Keep the kitchen clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards.
  • Monitor stock, order ingredients and keep waste low.

  • 3 Years' Experience as a Chef
  • Hotel, apartment or restaurant kitchen background
  • Able to cook Nigerian and continental dishes
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Opportunity to grow with a hospitality company and receive training.
  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Sales Assistant
job.description:
We are hiring a Sales Assistant for a clothing store in Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for a presentable, confident communicator who is comfortable handling fabrics and can resume immediately.

Responsibilities

  • Welcome customers, understand what they are looking for and help them choose the right clothing and fabrics.
  • Handle, fold and display fabrics and clothing with care, and keep the shop floor tidy.
  • Keep the store presentable and report stock and customer requests to the store management.

Requirements

  • 1-2 Years' Experience in Sales or Retail
  • Good communication skills
  • Presentable and comfortable handling fabrics
  • Able to commute to Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Other statutory benefits.
